biggest_catch: The live terms page (linked from Avadian's current 'Get $100 Every Time You Refer a Friend' call-to-action) states the payout but does not fully spell out what the referred friend must DO beyond opening an approved new account - the exact qualifying requirements are vague on the page itself.
catches: Referrer must be a current Avadian member with an account in good standing who has not previously caused a loss to the credit union.
Limit one per household; referring members may receive a maximum of $500 in referrals per calendar year.
New accounts are subject to approval and membership eligibility; minimum opening deposit required for checking products.
Not valid if the 'new account' is opened by an existing Avadian member; not available to employees, board members, or related persons.
'Refer a Friend' bonus is considered interest and will be reported on IRS 1099-INT.
$100 added to both members' share (savings) accounts within 60 days of the new member opening their account, once all requirements are met.
Offer subject to change without notice.
Note: the page does not enumerate the friend's specific qualifying actions beyond new account opening, so confirm current requirements before referring.

steps: Click 'Refer Now' on Avadian's membership page to reach the official referral form on promo.avadiancu.com.
Submit your referral so your friend is tracked as referred by you.
Friend opens a new approved Avadian account per membership eligibility requirements.
$100 is added to your share (savings) account within 60 days of the new member opening their account.
timing: $100 added to both members' share (savings) accounts within 60 days of the new member opening their account, once all requirements are met.
when_cash_arrives: $100 added to both members' share (savings) accounts within 60 days of the new member opening their account, once all requirements are met. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
